summary.result: The relative compressive strengths of RPPC after 300 cycles of freezing and thawing against the compressive strength before freezing and thawing test are in the range of 89 $\sim$ $96\%$ .
summary.background: The void ratios of RPPC are in the range of 15 $\sim$ $24\%$ , showing the tendency that it is reduced to a great extent as the mixing ratio of the binder increases.
summary.method: The permeability coefficients of RPPC are in the range of $6.3\times$ $10_{-1}$ $\sim$ $1.5\times$ $10_{-2}$ cm/s.
